        & ($isNilOrEmpty($state.context.LOCAL.failC.id) ? "NONE" : $join([$state.context.LOCAL.failC.id],", "))

        & ($isNilOrEmpty($state.context.LOCAL.failU.id) ? "NONE" : $join([$state.context.LOCAL.failU.id],", "))
        & "), Facility ID: ("
        & ($isNilOrEmpty($state.context.LOCAL.failF.id) ? "NONE" : $join([$state.context.LOCAL.failF.id],", "))
        & "), Workcenter ID: ("
        & ($isNilOrEmpty($state.context.LOCAL.failW.id) ? "NONE" : $join([$state.context.LOCAL.failW.id],", ")) & ")",
     
      "typeId": "Failure"
    }
  }
